sections.title: Birthdays and Presents
sections.content: A birthday brings its own small set of words, and most of the verbs around it are regular ones you can already build: decorar, cantar, and escribir, which is the -ir verb from Lesson 6 put to work.

items.spanish: Kaylee decora la sala con globos.
items.english: Kaylee decorates the living room with balloons.

items.spanish: Todos cantan, y Meg abre sus regalos.
items.english: Everyone sings, and Meg opens her presents.

items.spanish: Es un cuaderno para escribir palabras nuevas en español.
items.english: It's a notebook for writing new Spanish words in.

sections.content: 'El cumpleaños' ends in -s but is singular — one birthday, 'el cumpleaños'; several, 'los cumpleaños'. The word itself never changes.
